records.summary: Windows DrawSVG source preparation returns no executable runtime command
records.observation: Actual Windows source-only preparation preserved the pinned ManiSkill archive, DrawSVG adapter and project lock. It returned needs_configuration with source_ready_runtime_not_prepared, no environment directory, environment_created=false and next_command=null.
records.resolution: Use --download-only to preserve source on Windows. Prepare the isolated runtime and execute the returned task command separately on the documented Linux environment.

evidence.result: Command completed source preparation in the existing isolated Windows test project; source/archive hashes and lock were preserved. Paths redacted. No environment, dependency installation, simulator import or robot execution occurred.

hub_validation.result: Exact catalog pins and bounded finding fields checked; no robot execution.

records.summary: CPU-only SAPIEN initialization needs a Vulkan ICD even with rendering output disabled
records.observation: On Ubuntu 22.04, the pinned PickCube CPU/state recipe installed successfully but failed with failed to find a rendering device when no usable Vulkan ICD was present. The same source, adapter and package versions subsequently completed seed 0 after enabling Mesa lavapipe.
records.resolution: On the tested Ubuntu 22.04 host, install libvulkan1 and mesa-vulkan-drivers, then set VK_ICD_FILENAMES=/usr/share/vulkan/icd.d/lvp_icd.x86_64.json before invoking the prepared command. Keep sim_backend=cpu and render_backend=none. This does not establish other platforms or graphics modes.

evidence.result: GitHub Actions run 39042278396 failed during scene initialization without a rendering device. Run 39042625468 used a CPU llvmpipe device and completed PickCube-v1 seed 0: success=true, elapsed_steps=74, exit=0, no timeout or retry. Source archive and adapter hashes were unchanged.

hub_validation.result: Exact catalog pins and bounded finding fields checked; no robot execution.

records.summary: Earlier PickCube completion evidence did not enforce the 50-step episode horizon
records.observation: The completion wording in memory mem_63eb7c608c662840d1a97fdbedf9529111b94026186d2ae12e4bc901b26ef350 needs qualification. For Hub record contrib-a5dd78ad4e1d4e3d at source 33967b9e3ead1f841eec57cc9f31d0d8b8cf0907, run 39042625468 reported final-state success=true at 74 steps, beyond the upstream PickCube-v1 50-step episode budget. The old wrapper neither reported nor rejected truncation. Success within 50 steps is not established; this is not evidence of a failed standard-horizon benchmark. The Vulkan initialization workaround is separate from horizon-validated task completion.
records.resolution: Evaluate Hub recipe version 1.1.0 in a separate project without changing the old project lock. It keeps the upstream source pin and explicitly sets max_episode_steps=1000 as a Hub planning budget, not an upstream default. Completion requires success=true, truncated=false and 0 < elapsed_steps < 1000; output includes terminated, truncated and max_episode_steps. New-version runtime verification requires fresh exact-pin evidence and cannot be inferred from the old 74-step output.

evidence.result: Source/documentation audit of the pinned PickCube-v1 registration, old wrapper and preserved task.stdout.txt from run 39042625468. The source registers max_episode_steps=50; the recorded final output has elapsed_steps=74 and lacks terminated/truncated fields. No new robot task was executed for this correction, and no runtime verification of version 1.1.0 is supplied.

hub_validation.result: Exact catalog pins and bounded finding fields checked; no robot execution.
